title: Battle of St. Kitts (1629)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of St. Kitts (1629)", at revision 1370589842, opens: "The Battle of St. Kitts or St. Cristopher was a successful Spanish expedition that seized the islands of Saint Kitts and Nevis from the English and French during the Anglo-Spanish War (1625–30)." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4872428, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "Spanish capture of St. Kitts in 1629". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (from Q763, the country the item names): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
